_about: Every part Nestegg builds, one environment each (CL-1). Read by install_parts.py. Source: the 11/22 package accounting (/mnt/project-files/package-accounting/PACKAGE_ACCOUNTING_2026-11-22.md, sections A-C) and the proven pod kit POD_CALIB_GPU_v5.sh. Jake 11/22 12:20 AM CT: anything used or referenced is part of the build. Versions owned by a part's own files (lock files, download scripts, side-env scripts) are read from there at install time, never re-typed here.

torch.note: torch comes from each part's known-good list (PyPI: CUDA 12 build on Linux, CPU build on Windows); these pins are checked against that list

lock.about: Known-good lists and measured hashes in locks/ (copied byte for byte from the package accounting thread's backup; locks/SOURCE_SHA256.txt has the source hashes). One set of lists: changes are made there and copied here.

colorama.why: these use colorama only on Windows, so a list measured on Linux leaves it out; pip check on Windows names anything else

probe.about: modules of vendored libraries that no shipped code reaches, and outside names never imported on the Pythons we install; each entry prints as INFO 'not probed' with its reason
